svg.aria-label: The Diary of Neid: Ngô Hoàng Dương, AI researcher. Projects in computer vision, tracking, AI agents and apps.
svg.title: The Diary of Neid — Ngô Hoàng Dương

g.text: I build AI agents and the pipelines around them, and
computer-vision systems that follow people through
real video: detection, tracking and ReID across
Agents that plan, call tools and keep memory and context across
Putting LLMs and VLMs to work end to end: agentic object
Detection, captioning and face analysis built to run on real video,
Keeping identities stable over time and across cameras: BoT-SORT,
every entry, in the order I keep them
Multi-camera tracking with a global ID module: merges
per-camera tracks into cross-camera identities, with
homography computation for a shared map. Includes a
written analysis comparing merge and conflict-resolution
A standalone, minimal tracking package: YOLOv7 detection,
detection, long-term ReID in Qdrant, and a multi-camera
demo that assigns global IDs and draws tracks on a shared
A Tracking + ReID system built on BoxMOT. It combines
BoT-SORT/DeepOCSORT with short- and long-term ReID
(OSNet, ArcFace, Qdrant), plus Pending ID and Assign ID
Manager logic for handling ID swaps.
A supervision workspace based on BoxMOT, with face
A FastAPI web service that takes an uploaded video and
aligns and crops faces with dlib's 68-point landmarks, then
models that reason, look and act
A 5-step agentic object detection pipeline. VLMs (GPT-4o,
o1) act as reasoners and reviewers with chain-of-thought
A trimmed BLIP caption toolkit for training and inference: a
single-image CLI, a web app, and a video captioner that
captions frames and overlays the text on the video.
An end-to-end, agent-driven pipeline for data collection,
model training, and automated dataset generation (early
A chatbot built with Rasa NLU and Core: intents, entities,
things I build on the side
ProjectEllie, a personal productivity app for finances,
schedules and tasks. It also has journal, goals, focus and
mind-map views, an assistant, and a 3D VRM companion.
